scope.browserEventSettlementScope: Registered owned Page events until existing context/browser close, same-ingress transport and all observed Page errors, console errors and crashes.

nativePrimaryDocumentRetirement.bindingAdmission: One owned Page, its bound Context and main Frame, one closed record and a Page-local key, matching only the exact previously observed document.
nativePrimaryDocumentRetirement.snapshotAdmission: Driver-observed native primary navigation with exact ingress, one fresh document ID, and the existing native route readiness and final URL guards.
nativePrimaryDocumentRetirement.documentScope: Top-level native primary documents at the fixed HTTPS ingress. Flush queued DOM mutations and scan connected main in the trusted pagehide callback, then disconnect. This closes the document observation window at that callback.
nativePrimaryDocumentRetirement.receiptWait: At most one outstanding wait per Page, charged to the remaining fixed 90-second navigation budget and the protected native course clock.
nativePrimaryDocumentRetirement.transportLimits: Installed Playwright binding registration, init scripts and evaluate rely on the still-unissued protected process watchdog. An execution-context-disposed reply does not acknowledge transport. Only the received Node callback may acknowledge an exact retiring document.
nativePrimaryDocumentRetirement.payloadStored: Only per-Page counts of admission, retirement, refusal, inert completion and documents with each marker kind. No document IDs, key, page text, selector contents or raw binding records.
nativePrimaryDocumentRetirement.outOfScope: Changes occurring after the pagehide callback or discarded before MutationObserver/current connected-main inspection are outside this DOM observation. Existing Page transport/JS listeners remain through owned cleanup.
